audit.why: Sivir out-ranges mana-starved early Zeri, it evens 4-5 as she nears her spike, and her wall-dash kiting takes over post-item — matches packet levelChart.

edits.before: Late Zeri is one of the best kiting hyper-carries in the game; her Lightning Crash overdrive plus wall-dashing mobility beats your straight-line kite, and Spell Shield only blocks a single ability of her rapid Q spam. Use On the Chase (R) and Ricochet AoE to disengage and cleave, but never try to duel her; play for zoning and let your frontline close the gap on her.
edits.after: Late Zeri is one of the best kiting hyper-carries in the game; her Lightning Crash overdrive plus wall-dashing mobility beats your straight-line kite, and Spell Shield only blocks a single ability of her rapid Q spam. edits.before: - Zeri Spark Surge: matchup-defining — The wall-dash escape — she is catchable only while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Spell Shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Zeri's Spark Surge (E) is down 24s at rank 1, 18s at max — she's catchable only while it's down. Her combo opens with a reset auto (Living Battery) — step back on the wind-up. - Spell Shield (E) shares that 24s/18s clock — save it for the dash punish.

edits.before: Q the contact both ways, W-bounce the duo, walk — the trade taxed two people and refunded your mana bar.
edits.after: Bait Spark Surge first — the E only eats a targeted cast, so let her dash before you spend your shield.

edits.after: Zeri's wall-dash resets her spacing on a falling cooldown — chasing her trades your tempo for hers.
